messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout release/rdw-opt-2.4.0 -> prod (canary 10% for 30m)
maria: heads-up — kicking off the change window. watching prod SLOs: 99p latency 200ms, availability 99.95% :eyes:
aj: will follow canary grafana panels, link https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/9Xl3/slo-overview?env=prod
sam.k: bumped model-serving container image and a small kv-cache tweak, nothing that should affect routing
deploy-bot: canary deployed to 4 hosts, healthchecks OK (http 200 on /health)
monitoring-bot: alert (SLO): spike in 5xx rate for embeddings-prod (0.85% over 5m, threshold 0.5%) — firing incident-3452
maria: seeing the same on the chart, errors concentrated on region us-west2, tracing shows increased timeout to embedder
aj: trending errors line up with canary hosts only. attaching short logs:
```
2026-03-19T22:00:12Z embed-service ERROR request failed code=502 path=/v1/embeddings model=embed-rdw-1.13
2026-03-19T22:00:13Z embed-service ERROR downstream timeout ms=1200 host=canary-03
```
sam.k: hmm — we did pin the model weight to v1.13 in this release. previous stable was v1.12. I pushed a config to enable stricter timeouts for v1.13
maria: options: 1) rollback canary 2) pin canary back to model v1.12 3) increase timeout and continue to watch. prefer quick rollback to avoid user impact
aj: agree with rollback for canary only. keep prod stable. i can kick the rollback command
aj: /deploy rollback release/rdw-opt-2.4.0 --scope=canary --reason="5xx spike embeddings"
deploy-bot: rollback started for canary hosts (IDs: canary-01,canary-02,canary-03,canary-04). scaling down new pods, restoring image redwood/api:2.3.9
monitoring-bot: alert updated: incident-3452 — mitigation in progress (rollback in effect)
maria: thanks. i'm watching SLO panels and traces. tagging eng-ml to follow postmortem for model v1.13
sam.k: noted — will open a quick PR to revert model pin in canary and run regression eval on v1.13 against embed testset
monitoring-bot: SLOs returning toward baseline — 5xx rate down to 0.12% over 5m
deploy-bot: rollback complete for canary, all canary traffic back to stable release/rdw-opt-2.3.9
maria: marking this deploy window as paused for prod until we validate the embed model. adding a note to release notes: "Canary rolled back due to embedding 5xx spike; investigating model v1.13" :memo:
aj: will keep an eye for any followups, removing alert noise. :thumbsup:
monitoring-bot: incident-3452 resolved (root cause suspected model v1.13 latency regression). follow-up: eng-ml to run perf ev and eng-releases to coordinate next canary attempt
maria: logging postmortem stub and action items in #postmortems. thanks folks.
